cohort: The study included 1,027 infants born to women treated with anti-TNF-a biologic therapy, with a comparison group of women on non-biologic systemic treatment.
finding: Treatment with anti-TNF-a biologic therapy was associated with an increased prevalence of preterm birth and cesarean delivery when compared to non-biologic systemic treatment.
mod_finding: An increased prevalence of cesarean delivery (aOR, 1.57; 95% CI, 1.35-1.82) was observed in women treated with anti-TNF-a biologic therapy.
gest_age: preterm birth, small for gestational age
